page.overview:
What is Rhisso?

Rhisso was a planetoid, perhaps belonging to the League of Nobles. It was populated by miners.

In 166 BG sleeping gas erupted inside the living domes and the miners disappeared. They were taken as slaves by the Tleilaxu, but the event was attributed to the Thinking Machines.
